decisions: A request for an unheld Attachment Lease is granted immediately.
Exactly one transfer request may wait behind a healthy Lease Holder.
The Lease Holder retains live authority while transfer is requested.
Only the Lease Holder may approve or deny a healthy transfer request.
Release, hide, close, detach, explicit switch, or expiry promotes the pending requester; without one the lease becomes unheld.
A Lease Holder may renew while a transfer request is pending, without clearing that request.

events.effect: Attach; grant immediately when unheld, otherwise become Observer.
Grant when unheld; otherwise record one pending requester without displacing the Lease Holder.
Promote the requester and start a fresh lease deadline.
Clear the requester while preserving the holder and existing deadline.
Start a fresh deadline and preserve any pending requester.
Promote the requester or make the lease unheld; the releasing surface remains an Observer.
Unregister the surface; if it held the lease, promote the requester or make the lease unheld.
Release deliberately and promote the pending requester.
Advance deterministic time; at the deadline, expire and promote the requester or make the lease unheld.
Advance the transcript only for the Lease Holder; reject Observer input without state mutation.
Route only for the Lease Holder; reject Observer mouse events without state mutation.
Update surface projection state without changing lease authority.

invariants: Agent Session identity never changes across attachment or lease transitions.
There are zero or one Lease Holders and zero or one pending requesters.
The Lease Holder and pending requester are attached and are different Surface Attachments.
Every held lease has one finite deadline; an unheld lease has none.
A pending transfer does not reduce the Lease Holder's live authority.
Observer live-input and interactive-mouse attempts are rejected without authoritative state mutation.
History reads and focus reports never grant or transfer an Attachment Lease.
Release and expiry promote the pending requester; without one they leave the lease unheld.
Renewal preserves a pending requester while replacing the deadline.
Only accepted Lease Holder live input advances the canonical transcript revision.
